title: Book 7 — Polymnia, Chapter 206
paragraphs: These the Spartans had sent out first with Leonidas, so that the other allies, seeing them, would join the campaign, and for fear that they too might side with the Medes if they heard that the Spartans were delaying their action. Afterwards, once they had completed their festival (the festival of the Carneia stood in their way), they intended to leave a garrison in Sparta and come to help in full force with all speed. Likewise the rest of the allies had thought to do the same, for it happened that the Olympic festival fell at the same time as these events. Since they did not suppose the fighting at Thermopylae would be decided so quickly, they sent only the forerunners of their force.
